payload.contentHtml:
Nous Research
Hermes Agent wrote a novel.

"The Second Son of the House of Bells" runs 79,456 words across 19 chapters.

The agent built its own pipeline to do it, using the ame modify-evaluate-keep/discard loop as @karpathy
's Autoresearch but applied to fiction: world-building, chapter drafting, adversarial editing, Opus review loops, LaTeX typesetting, cover art, audiobook generation, and landing page setup.

Book: http://nousresearch.com/bells
Code: http://github.com/NousResearch/autonovel…
Hermes Agent 写了一部小说。

《贝尔家的次子》共计79456字，分为19章。

该代理构建了自己的流程来完成这项工作，使用 ame modify-evaluate-keep/discard 循环作为 @karpathy 的自动研究，但应用于小说创作：世界观构建、章节撰写、对抗性编辑、Opus 评审循环、LaTeX 排版、封面设计、有声书生成以及落地页设置。

书籍： http://nousresearch.com/bells
代码: http://github.com/NousResearch/autonovel…
@theemozilla

it's been a longstanding dream of mine build an ai system that can tell a compelling story. it's what got me started in the space in the beginning, and with Hermes Agent I finally pulled it off 100% written, typeset, etc. by Hermes Agent those at our gtc event got hard copies🤗
这一直是我的一个长期梦想，构建一个能够讲述引人入胜故事的人工智能系统。这是我最初投身这个领域的原因，而借助 Hermes Agent，我终于实现了它。 100% 由 Hermes Agent 编写、排版等完成 参加我们 GTC 活动的人员拿到了纸质版 🤗

热门回复

@Andrej Karpathy ♥ 160 · 💬 7

Huh! Love the idea. Not exactly verifiable but might still work quite well given some effort
哈！喜欢这个想法。虽然不太能验证，但只要付出一些努力，可能仍然会效果相当不错。

@Nous Research ♥ 85 · 💬 11

I’m going to read it to your mom
我要读给你妈妈听

@Nous Research ♥ 53 · 💬 1

How Autonovel works:
Autonovel 如何运作：

@André Luís ♥ 10 · 💬 2

who's gonna read it? another agent?
谁会读它？另一个代理？

@0x_Vivek ♥ 3 · 💬 0

adversarial editing for fantasy novels is wild.

an agent roasting its own plot holes using an autoresearch loop is the real unlock.

can't wait for the ai goodreads drama.
奇幻小说的对抗性编辑太疯狂了。

一个智能体通过自动研究循环暴露自身的逻辑漏洞，这才是真正的解锁。

等不及 AI Goodreads 的戏剧了
